technology.summary: Today's technology news includes the announcement of a $30 million funding round for AI-native software startup Vesta, led by Conversion Capital. Uber and China's Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London, while Nvidia aims to make robotaxis and humanoid robots safer with physical AI. Microsoft has debuted new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes, and Google has released a new local-first Granola competitor. China's Manus has raised over $500 million in its first funding round since splitting with Meta, and India has rejected Elon Musk's claim of discrimination over the Starlink launch. In gaming news, GTA VI leaks continue with a lengthy gameplay video featuring a naked Jason running around Vice City.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a decline in Indian equity benchmarks due to profit booking and rising oil prices, with the Nifty 50 index closing down by 95.75 points. Benchmark indices also faced a decline as global uncertainty impacted the market and investor sentiment remained cautious. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to enhance regulatory procedures and make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. In a landmark ruling, the Supreme Court of India highlighted troubling markups on cancer drugs enforced by hospitals, leading to a steep drop in the BSE Hospitals Index and notable losses for industry giants.

politics.summary: The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. The Supreme Court is set to list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress has condemned the detention of tribal students who were headed to Mumbai to protest. Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC, claiming his ability to execute illegal orders makes him a liability for the country. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has cited a non-existent Indian election to call the US electoral process 'corrupt'.
